content.answer: Fix rule: merge options by stable id — existing option names must keep their old ids (pass the original option objects through unchanged), and only genuinely new names get fresh ids continuing from max(existing id)+1; never rebuild the option list by name alone, because that mints brand-new ids and silently clears every existing row's value reference.
content.reuse_advice: For any update to an id-referenced catalog (single-select/multi-select fields, statuses, tags, etc.), never send a name-only list that replaces the whole catalog. Instead: read the current catalog, diff by stable id (and name), carry existing entries forward with their original ids and objects, assign new ids only to genuinely new entries starting at max(existing id)+1, and delete only entries you truly intend to remove — otherwise all existing records' references will be silently broken.
